MOSSBBoxImageAnalysis: MOSS BBOX Image Analysis: one reference image to one prompt card, Auto or explicit target, editable system prompt and Core generation settings; switch OFF to edit saved analysis.
MOSSBBoxReferenceCrop: MOSS BBOX Reference Crop: crop one reference-image box for optional local text analysis; never changes prompt bodies or saves preview files.
MOSSBBoxTextLink: MOSS BBOX Text Link: connect external STRING text to a Canvas box through Prompter; preserves manual text and supports multiple Exports.
MOSSBBoxPreview: MOSS BBOX Preview: display generated images with optional boxes and opacity; original IMAGE passes through unchanged.
MOSSSharedCanvas: MOSS BBOX Canvas: seven-color layout, independent per-box prompts and reference-image input.
MOSSSharedPrompter: MOSS BBOX Prompter: scene and color prompts with Character, Object and Text types.
MOSSFromKrea2: MOSS BBOX Export: hybrid, caption, layout_json or auto output with centralized pixel bounding boxes.
MOSSBBoxCanvasPrompt: Legacy combined MOSS BBOX Canvas + Prompt; retained for existing workflows.
MOSSBBoxCanvas: Legacy separate MOSS BBOX Canvas; retained for existing workflows.
MOSSBBoxPrompter: Legacy separate MOSS BBOX Prompter; retained for existing workflows.
